steps: Sign in to Netlify; this is User settings → Applications → Personal access tokens
Enter a descriptive name and choose an expiration
Click 'Generate token', copy it and click 'Done' — it is shown exactly once
A personal token cannot reach teams that require SAML sign-in until you authorise it for them

least_privilege.summary: Set a short expiration; a personal token has your whole account's reach, so do not share it.
